Name: No Wind Debris
Author: PfluorescentZebra
Description:
No Wind Debris edits the cursors file to replace the leaves and petals with a completely transparent image.  I decided to create this mod to help reduce the vertigo triggering I was having on windy days.  

Requires Content Patcher.

This should not conflict with any mods, though if another CP mod is editing the same coordinates of the cursors file the visuals may show up incorrectly.  If you do have any errors, please tell me the exact wording of the error in the console and screenshots if possible.  

Hope you find this mod useful, have a great day in the valley!
